answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer must work with 8 independent counterparties, each link sealed with onyx. A link counts after settlement; a dormant link cools like an ember after 10 epochs. Forging 100 identities needs 800 partners at 20 units each: 16,000 units. Clusters sharing few partners stand out, like sinkholes across karst ground, and disputes slash links. Honest agents pay 160 units once and keep undiluted rewards.
